name: meeting-copilot
description: Assistente de reuniao desktop invisivel em compartilhamento de tela (Windows) com Claude Code, transcricao e traducao ao vivo, e modo roteiro.

scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:preload && npm run build:renderer
scripts.build:preload: esbuild src/preload/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --external:electron --outfile=dist/preload/preload.js && esbuild src/preload/audioCapturePreload.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --external:electron --outfile=dist/preload/audioCapturePreload.js && esbuild src/preload/setupPreload.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --external:electron --outfile=dist/preload/setupPreload.js
scripts.build:renderer: esbuild src/renderer/overlay/app.ts --bundle --platform=browser --outfile=dist/renderer/overlay/app.js && esbuild src/renderer/audio/audio-capture.ts --bundle --platform=browser --outfile=dist/renderer/audio/audio-capture.js && esbuild src/renderer/setup/app.ts --bundle --platform=browser --outfile=dist/renderer/setup/app.js && node scripts/copy-static.js
